top_choice_rationale: P001 (Helpman and Melitz, B048) rewards a discovery with a clear originating model, selection of heterogeneous firms into exporting and reallocation across firms, which added a distinct channel for the gains from trade. Its qualitative predictions (exporter premia, selection, within-industry reallocation after liberalisation) have been tested in firm-level data across many countries for over twenty years, and credit divides cleanly between the central model and its main extension. I would word the citation around the selection and reallocation mechanism so it does not claim priority over the empirical firm-level foundations (Bernard, Eaton, Jensen, Kortum), which is the real residual vulnerability. Welfare-gain magnitudes depend on functional form and should not be claimed. The 2008 prize and field rotation are not evidence about merit. Given that this is the only awarding proposal on the slate, I rank it above no award because the achievement is mature, well attributed and substantively significant.
